subject: Reschedule: short exec overview + deep-dive — aligning to sponsor window

Subject: Quick note — aligning demo to your exec window

Alex — thanks again for the time last week. We had you down for the full product walkthrough on Jan 6. I just heard from Marissa (internal) that your CTO/VP asked to join a short executive overview but will only be available in the morning window on Jan 7 (08:30–09:15 PT).

Before I push calendar changes I wanted to check two options that should keep momentum:
- Option A: Move the Jan 6 full walkthrough to Jan 8 and schedule a focused 30-minute executive overview on Jan 7 at 08:45 PT (high-level value, ROI bullets, Q&A).
- Option B: Keep the Jan 6 slot for the deep demo, and add a separate 30-minute executive snapshot on Jan 7 morning — effectively splitting the session.

If the sponsor can only join Jan 7 morning, Option A guarantees the exec hears the high-level narrative first; Option B gives devs the full time while still getting sponsor alignment. Which do you prefer?

I attached a tight 30-min agenda and the deep-dive outline so you can see the split. If you want, we can set the exec slot as a standing 30-minute preview and keep the technical session recorded.

Thanks — I can send invites as soon as you confirm.

—Sean

We prefer Option A if possible: move the full walkthrough to Jan 8 and have a 30-min exec overview on Jan 7 at 08:45 PT. That gives our procurement team time to review any materials before the deep dive.

Can you confirm the executive agenda focuses on: business outcomes, cost/latency tradeoffs, and deployment options (hosted vs private)? Also please include a one-pager for procurement.

Thanks — Alex
